_note: Direct-source RSS/Atom feeds for the ACTU radar — trade/general press that GDELT does not index well (which starved the daily radar 05-07 Sep 2026). Each feed is read for title+link+date only (press review, A-20); classify() writes our neutral summary and links back. `curated` is declared PER FEED and true ONLY for a vetted DC NEWSROOM (every article is DC-relevant): such a feed is trusted and gated on EDITORIAL INTEREST (no confidence gate, a named person does not block). A general outlet keeps curated:false → its items pass the SAME GDELT-style confidence gate (neutral topic, no named person, high confidence, not a project), just over an RSS transport; this still needs the domain in allowlist.json to auto-publish. Keep the list small; prefer a DC/tech/pro SECTION feed over a general one. Adding a feed is a reviewable PR. NEUTRALITÉ (Franck 2026-09-22): only outlets that REPORT a fact — PQR, public-service, institutional, trade — never MILITANT outlets (signal.EXCLUDED_SOURCE_DOMAINS drops them structurally, even when an aggregator surfaces them). An aggregator feed (Google News) carries the real outlet in <source url> → that outlet is what gets attributed, allow-listed and exclusion-checked.
